pages.title: Pocket Universe
pages.text: An entire cosmos, folded into a bubble small enough to hold. Inside it galaxies form, stars burn and die, all on its own clock. Its surface is smooth and faintly warm, and when I look closely I can see tiny points of light drifting inside. I try very hard not to drop it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Sending a Pocket Universe back along a Closed Timelike Curve with Chronon Gas in the Causality Loop Engine, it arrived before it left and there were two. Where the first came from is a question I avoid in this notebook.

Made in $(item)Causality Loop Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Causality Violation.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Notes III, Bubble Universe, Cherenkov Quartz, Closed Timelike Curve, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Dimensional Residue, Exotic Matter Crystal, Heat Death Remnant and more.
